what_to_detect: A flipped permanent on the battlefield has its alternative name, text, type line and power/toughness.
near_miss: An unflipped flip permanent, with its normal characteristics.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: A candidate whose target restriction reads colour has no legal target because a flipped permanent keeps its card's colour.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with a flipped permanent of another colour as a legal target.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: A candidate whose target restriction reads mana value has no legal target because a flipped permanent keeps its card's mana cost.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate with a flipped permanent whose mana value meets the restriction as a legal target.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: Effects applied to a permanent before it flips still apply to the flipped permanent, on top of its alternative power/toughness.
near_miss: Not distinct within the rule: the contrast is a flipped permanent with no earlier effect on it.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: A static whose affected set reads a characteristic (legendary, a name, a type) applies to a flipped permanent by its alternative characteristics.
near_miss: An unflipped flip permanent, which the same static does not affect because its normal characteristics fail the condition.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: A flipped permanent that left the battlefield and returns is unflipped, with its normal characteristics.
near_miss: A flipped permanent that stays on the battlefield and stays flipped.
record_fields: entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness

what_to_detect: A static that forbids by a chosen card name forbids the candidates of a flipped permanent whose alternative name is the name chosen.
near_miss: A chosen name that is the flip card's normal name while the permanent is flipped, so the static forbids nothing of it.
record_fields: gen-3 card chosen (the static's chosen name)
entity name, types, subtypes, colors, power/toughness
